# Cedar meeting room booking policy

This is a fictional guide for testing ChatMind, not a university policy.
Cedar accommodates four people. Each booking may last at most 60 minutes.
To book Cedar, open the room calendar, choose an available slot of 60 minutes
or less, and submit the booking. A 90-minute booking is not permitted.

## Cedar booking cancellations

Cancel an unused booking in the room calendar before its start time.

## Cedar room equipment

Cedar has a display and a whiteboard. Bring your own laptop adapter.
